description.value: Monashee Motel is a motel situated on the Trans-Canada Highway in Sicamous, BC — a lakeside town known as the "Houseboat Capital of Canada" at the junction of Shuswap and Mara Lakes. The property offers modern rooms with Smart TVs, mini-fridges, microwaves, and Tempur-Pedic mattress options, along with free outdoor parking and a pet-friendly policy. Its Trans-Canada location makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists traveling through the Thompson-Okanagan corridor.

address.value: 1333 Trans-Canada Highway, Sicamous, British Columbia V0E 2V1, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM data on name, address, and phone. The site explicitly mentions free Wi-Fi in all rooms and common areas, free outdoor parking, and pet-friendly policy, but makes no mention of bike storage, bike handling, laundry, drying area, or any cyclist-specific services. In-room amenities (mini-fridge, microwave, coffee maker, Smart TV) are confirmed from the rooms subpage.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational motel with an active website, confirmed address, and 24-hour front desk — a legitimate accommodation stop for Trans-Canada cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address (monasheemotel@yahoo.ca) found on contact subpage but not present in OSM tags.
